checks: qualified-vs-qualified: healthy qualified route serves before saturation

scenarios.name: staleVsQualified
checks: stale-vs-qualified: >30d receipt reads as expired (no verdict)
stale-vs-qualified: stale evidence never excludes — legacy eligibility preserved

stale-vs-qualified: stale route flags bounded requalification, not quarantine

scenarios.name: crossProviderFailover

cross-provider: the limited provider is never selected while parked

cross-provider: zero leaked reservations

scenarios.name: roleMismatch
checks: role-mismatch: REVIEWER work lands on the reviewer-role route, never the coder-only route
role-mismatch: CODER work lands on the coder-role route

scenarios.name: expiredRequalification
checks: expired-requalification: current HARD_FAILURE receipt excludes the route
expired-requalification: expired HARD_FAILURE reverts to legacy eligibility
expired-requalification: fresh receipt restores the route on the next decide
expired-requalification: zero leaked reservations

scenarios.name: allExhaustedFailsClosed
checks: all-exhausted: genuinely exhausted supply queues instead of inventing capacity
all-exhausted: a queued decision selects nothing — nothing billable is held
all-exhausted: zero leaked reservations
